items.headline: Tyler Fredricson moves to FC Lausanne-Sport on permanent deal
items.summary: 21-year-old centre-back leaves Old Trafford permanently to join Swiss club Lausanne-Sport. Deal includes sell-on and buy-back clauses.

items.headline: Iliman Ndiaye valued at £70m as Carrick seeks Rashford replacement
items.summary: Michael Carrick informed Everton's Iliman Ndiaye valued at around £70m in pursuit of winger options. United face Saudi Pro League competition for the target.

items.headline: Roma exploring Rashford loan with Manu Kone exchange deal
items.summary: Italian club Roma interested in taking Rashford on loan as part of player-plus-cash structure to bring French midfielder Manu Kone to Old Trafford for around £51m.

items.headline: Youri Tielemans signed from Aston Villa via release clause
items.summary: United activated release clause to sign 29-year-old midfielder Tielemans from Aston Villa in a quick deal as part of summer strengthening.
